priceless.linePrev: I never would've known from that look on your face
priceless.line: Lost in your current like a priceless wine
priceless.lineNext: The more that you say, the less I know
stanza: I'm like the water when your ship rolled in that night
Rough on the surface, but you cut through like a knife
And if it was an open-shut case
I never would've known from that look on your face
Lost in your current like a priceless wine
